cards.entity: Anglican Retirement Villages, Diocese of Sydney
cards.claim: Anglican Retirement Villages, Diocese of Sydney is an integral part of Anglicare Sydney.
cards.quote: Anglican Retirement Villages, Diocese of Sydney, is, in fact, an integral part of Anglicare Sydney. This relationship is not merely a coincidence; rather, it is a deliberate design, born out of a shared vision to serve the community. Evidence of this connection can be found in the governance structure of Anglican Retirement Villages. The organization is overseen by the Anglicare Sydney Board, which ensures that the values and mission of Anglicare Sydney are upheld in the provision of retirement village services. This shared governance structure is a testament to the symbiotic relationship between the two organizations. Furthermore, Anglican Retirement Villages, Diocese of Sydney, is listed as a subsidiary of Anglicare Sydney in the Australian Charities and Not-for-profits Commission (ACNC) register.
